title: Elastic capture seqcheck for prefill race mitigation and safe replay fallbacks
creator: Elena Park
description:
Problem: We intermittently observe corrupted outputs or silent hangs during multi-stream prefill + capture when two streams have overlapping but non-identical prefill token sequences. Root cause analysis points to nondeterministic kernel selection combined with differences in KV-cache alignment and segment boundaries which cause cudaGraph captures to diverge and later replay incorrect kernels. Goals: 1) Detect divergent prefill state at capture time with minimal added latency; 2) Provide a low-cost, deterministic fallback path for replay when divergence is detected; 3) Keep steady-state p50/p95 token latency regression under 5% for common workloads. Proposed solution: implement an "elastic capture sequence check" (seqcheck) mechanism:
- At prefill boundary, emit a compact epoch marker (64-bit hash + sequence id) into a per-stream capture header.
- During cudaGraph capture, validate header equality across expected capture participants; if mismatch, abort capture and route to deterministic fallback (stream-serial capture or temporary kernel-binding override).
- Add an adaptive backoff: if repeated mismatches occur for a stream, increase conservative capture isolation (disable certain kernel fusions / use safe kernels) for N windows before returning to optimistic capture.
- Provide an observability surface (capture mismatch metric, per-stream last-good-epoch, fallback-rate) and automatic canary rollout knobs (percentage of streams that use seqcheck abort vs soft-validation). Trade-offs considered: strict synchronization would eliminate mismatches but add latency; hashing-based seqcheck must avoid false positives from incidental differences (use stable serialization of prefill metadata); fallback strategies differ in cost (serial replay is slower but simple; kernel override cheaper but risks subtle perf variance). Implementation plan (milestones): M1: prototype seqcheck header emission + in-memory compare (unit tests + synthetic harness). M2: integrate into cudaGraph capture path and implement abort+fallback policy. M3: add metrics & dashboards, perf tests, and canary rollout. M4: rollout and monitor.
acceptance_criteria: Repro: Previously observed divergence reproduced deterministically in synthetic harness and fixed by seqcheck path
Metrics: capture_mismatch_rate reduced to <= 0.1% in canary with fallback enabled
Perf: end-to-end p50 token latency regression < 5% on representative workloads (chat and long-prefill) vs baseline
Tests: unit + e2e tests added to CI that simulate divergent prefill and assert safe fallback behavior
Deploy: canary rollout configuration validated (10% streams) and gradual ramp plan documented
comments: 2026-02-20 Elena Park: Filed initial bug report after reproducer from infra load test (link to incident: https://redwood.atlassian.com/INC-4231). Assigned to Rohit for design.

2026-02-24 Rohit Singh: Ran deterministic harness; confirmed kernel-binding ordering variance matters for short-prefill edge-cases. Patch idea: compact seq header + abort on mismatch. Prototype in branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2412
2026-02-27 Karan Mehta (PM): Agreed priority P0 due to customer-facing flakiness on Dedicated; requested acceptance criteria around perf guardrails.

2026-03-01 Design review (Anne Liu): Suggested stable serialization for header to avoid false positives; flagged UX for fallback metric in Console (link to spec: https://drive.redwood.com/designs/capture-seqcheck-v1).

2026-03-03 Bench results: microbench on A100x2 shows seqcheck header emission adds ~0.6ms per prefill on median; fallback (serial capture) increases p95 by ~18% on worst-case long-prefill. Exploring kernel-override fallback to reduce cost.

2026-03-04 Rohit Singh: Implemented adaptive backoff state machine and added Prometheus metrics: runtime.capture_mismatch_total and runtime.capture_fallback_count. Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd123/cuda-graph-capture
2026-03-05 Code review notes: PR 2412 needs cleaner header serialization and tests for epoch wrap-around; request from infra to add a feature flag for controlled canary rollout.
